def pack(weights, capacity):
    count = len(weights)
    if count == 0:
        return []
    states = 1 << count
    best = [(count + 1, capacity + 1)] * states
    choices = [None] * states
    best[0] = (1, 0)
    for mask in range(1, states):
        for index in range(count):
            bit = 1 << index
            if mask & bit:
                previous = mask ^ bit
                bins, load = best[previous]
                new_bin = load + weights[index] > capacity
                candidate = (bins + 1, weights[index]) if new_bin else (bins, load + weights[index])
                if candidate < best[mask]:
                    best[mask] = candidate
                    choices[mask] = (index, new_bin)
    actions = []
    mask = states - 1
    while mask:
        index, new_bin = choices[mask]
        actions.append((index, new_bin))
        mask ^= 1 << index
    bins = [[]]
    for index, new_bin in reversed(actions):
        if new_bin and bins[-1]:
            bins.append([])
        bins[-1].append(index)
    return bins

                    choices[mask] = (index, new_bin)
    actions = []
    mask = states - 1
    while mask:
        index, new_bin = choices[mask]
        actions.append((index, new_bin))
        mask ^= 1 << index
    bins = [[]]
    for index, new_bin in reversed(actions):
        if new_bin and bins[-1]:
            bins.append([])
        bins[-1].append(index)
    return bins
